original.verification: Read the bad-orbifold proof and finite-surface-cover explanation, the stated uniformization theorem, the orbifold Riemann–Hurwitz derivation, and the full good-base covering calculation. S2(3,4,3,4) is good with Euler characteristic -5/6; its degree-12 torsion-free cover has genus 6. For the principal circle subgroup the fibre degree is one, and Theorem 3.6 multiplies Euler number by the base degree. The negative Euler sign convention was matched to the independently computed connection orientation.
